data.question: top 5 states for foreign tourists in 2023
data.title: Top 5 states by foreign visits, 2023
data.sql: SELECT s.state_code, s.state_name, t.foreign_visits FROM tourism_annual AS t JOIN states AS s ON s.state_code = t.state_code WHERE t.year = 2023 ORDER BY t.foreign_visits DESC LIMIT 5
